description: Generate a minimal but runnable wdio.conf.ts for Appium + React Native testing, along with the npm install command.

androidAppPath.description: Path to the Android .apk when platform is both

androidDeviceName.description: Optional Android Appium device name when platform is both

androidPackageName.description: Android app package when platform is both

androidPlatformVersion.description: Optional Android version when platform is both

androidUdid.description: Optional Android device serial when platform is both

appPath.description: Path to .app / .apk (leave empty to use a running simulator)

bundleId.description: iOS bundle ID or Android app package

deviceName.description: Optional Appium device name for a single-platform config

iosAppPath.description: Path to the iOS .app when platform is both

iosBundleId.description: iOS bundle ID when platform is both

iosDeviceName.description: Optional iOS Appium device name when platform is both

iosPlatformVersion.description: Optional iOS version when platform is both

iosUdid.description: Optional iOS simulator UDID when platform is both

noReset.description: Preserve installed app data; false allows Appium to reset the app

outputPath.description: Shown in the output, not written to disk

platformVersion.description: Optional OS version for a single-platform config

udid.description: Optional device UDID / serial for a single-platform config

name: generate_wdio_config
